title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill Salts Blackcurrant Citrus 10ml E-Liquid
description: Blackcurrant Citrus from the Seriously Pod Fill Salts collection by Doozy Vape Co presents a sharp and refreshing fruit combination. The profile opens with the deep, dark sweetness of ripe Blackcurrants, establishing a rich and juicy foundation. This is instantly lifted by a splash of sharp Citrus on the exhale, providing a tangy and contrasting finish that keeps the palate refreshed. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. Seriously Pod Fill Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The Seriously Pod Fill Salts collection translates the vibrant flavours of disposable-style profiles into a versatile 10ml format. Offering a more cost-effective and flexible alternative, the range covers everything from juicy fruits to sweet dessert treats. Beyond Blackcurrant Citrus, vapers can explore other standout blends such as the succulent Blackcurrant Berry or the sweet Blueberry Pomegranate.
